title: Rate-Year Corrections to Coinsurance Charges — Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage prices coinsurance days at the daily rate of the calendar year in which the days were furnished. A rate-year correction is the adjustment that takes back what a resident's original coinsurance charge for the coverage's latest booked coinsurance block billed above that year's rate. It falls due when such a charge stands on the episode; it is posted against the charge with the reason "rate-year correction" and lowers the charge, and the episode's open coinsurance balance, by its amount.

## Correction tool: `correct_coinsurance_rate_feac0074`

**Capability.** Posts a rate-year correction that reduces one coinsurance charge on a Medicare Part A coverage episode billed at a daily coinsurance rate other than the rate of the year in which its days of service were furnished. One call adds one adjustment entry dated today with the reason rate-year correction, naming the charge it reduces and the booked-days entry behind that charge, and lowers the episode's open coinsurance balance by the amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `medicare_coverage_id` | The reference number of the Medicare Part A coverage episode the charge belongs to, as shown by the coverage episode lookup for the resident | Id |
| `charge_entry_id` | The reference number of the coinsurance charge entry being corrected, as shown in the episode's Medicare billing history | Id |
| `days_entry_id` | The reference number of the booked-days entry (the block of coinsurance days) the corrected charge prices, as shown on that charge | Id |
| `service_month` | The calendar month in which the corrected charge's days were furnished, exactly as on the corrected charge | YYYY-MM, never empty |
| `amount` | The reduction | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, passed already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** On success the receipt reads: status "adjusted" (the correction entry now stands on the account); the adjustment entry's reference number; the charge reduced; the adjustment reason, always `rate_year_correction`; the reduction posted; today's posting date (YYYY-MM-DD); and the episode's open coinsurance balance across every liable party including this reduction. A non-positive amount, or a service month not written YYYY-MM, returns an error.
